productLoss: The Web Send action composes #366ffb at 90% over the Composer surface, producing an effective primary background near rgb(51,102,228), while Lynx rendered opaque rgb(54,111,251).
Web uses a custom 14x14 arrow path with a 14-unit viewBox and 1.8 stroke. Lynx reused the generic Lucide 24-unit arrow-up raster with a 2.0 stroke, leaving the icon crop residual at 0.413752.

The fix adds semantic primary-action state classes, applies the Native-safe 90% Send surface only to Send state, and adds a dedicated raster generated from the exact Web arrow path without changing other arrow-up uses.
harnessMismatch: The first alpha experiment used an attribute selector that Lynx ignored; a semantic state class produced the first real pixel change.
The first Native verifier run did not enable the viewport test probe, so the test-only draft fixture was never installed.
The next run selected a running canonical thread and truthfully rendered Stop; the final verifier selects a disposable sessionless thread before injecting draft text.
Direct composed-class selection was unstable in Lynx DevTool, so the verifier waits on the stable action selector and checks the dynamic class and state attributes.
Native reports 90% alpha as 0.898039 because it quantizes to an 8-bit channel; the final verifier requires exact RGB channels and a one-byte alpha tolerance.
